integrity: The proof independently converts upward-flat chain rows to thresholds, derives the exact reflexivity and transitivity constraints, classifies the resulting suffix-minimum maps, and evaluates the fixed-point-set count by a Bell-number generating function. The primary full text was inspected at the flat/upward-flat definitions, frame correspondences for t_Box and 4_a, the upward-flat saturation result, and the finite-model-property theorem. Candidate-specific published-finding and literature searches did not locate the finite-chain Bell census.
scientific_limitations: The count is for upward-flat relations on a fixed finite chain satisfying the source correspondents of t_Box and 4_a. It does not enumerate raw unsaturated flat relations or frames over general finite posets, and it does not claim an optimal decision procedure.
title: Bell-number census for the S4-like finite-chain flat frames
